prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Write CommonJS module solution.js and export the named function.
Required API: exports.multisetOverlap = function(left, right) returning number[]
Behavior: Treat right as a multiset. Scan left in order and retain each value only while an unused equal occurrence remains in right. Preserve left order, do not mutate either input, and return a non-null empty result when there is no overlap.
Visible example: For left [3,1,3,2,3] and right [3,3,2], return [3,3,2].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: exports.multisetOverlap=function(left,right){const c=new Map();for(const x of right)c.set(x,(c.get(x)||0)+1);const out=[];for(const x of left){const n=c.get(x)||0;if(n>0){out.push(x);c.set(x,n-1)}}return out}
